@graph.comment: Allows multiple simultaneous read operations. All locks are threadsafe.

handlers.comment: Lets the RedisLocker run its boot-time hook. By default it keeps existing locks so instances sharing a namespace (HA) are not disturbed; set the locker's clearLocksOnStart to true for a single instance that should wipe stale locks on boot.
Makes sure the redis connection is closed when the application needs to stop. Also deletes still-existing locks and counters.
